ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and discrete high-intensity (white) circular pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black base across both lobes. High-intensity white annular and circular blobs (3-20 pixels in diameter) are non-uniformly distributed across the entire ventral surface, with specific clusters in the central and outer lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with an approximate angle of 50-60 degrees and a depth roughly equal to 15% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary, characterized by varying peak amplitudes (5-25 pixels) and jagged valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward curve from the median notch extending towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of white circular/ring-shaped pixel clusters (rosettes) across both lobes, varying in density with high concentration on the right lobe distal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Global circular scarring consistent with barnacle attachment; a distinct, raised biological protrusion (barnacle cluster) is visible on the terminal edge of the left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced localized cluster of barnacles on the extreme left distal tip creating an irregular geometric extension of the fluke profile.
